candidates.message: Your course just did Pasteur, and Gus is basically his research topic living on your counter: wild yeast and bacteria keeping each other in check. Has the course said anything about sourdough?
candidates.rationale: Links this week's Pasteur lecture to the starter they feed; Saturday morning is baking time.

candidates.message: Of everyone your science-history course has covered so far, who would you actually want to have dinner with?
candidates.rationale: A playful question about their course; less specific than c1.

candidates.message: Saturday morning, so I'm guessing Gus is getting fed. Bread on the menu this weekend?
candidates.rationale: Light remark matching their weekend baking habit.
